finalText:
All 40 tests pass. ✓

The issue was **premature rounding** on each discount step. When stacked discounts apply, intermediate rounding at 2 decimals truncates fractions. Those tiny losses then multiply when converting to JPY (×149 rate), turning subcent errors into full-yen discrepancies.

The fix keeps full precision through the discount chain and rounds only the final converted total — which matches the reference implementation and handles all currencies correctly, especially zero-decimal ones like JPY.
